criteria.text: GET /agent-sessions/:id/todo invokes the SDK todo wrapper and returns the list (vitest spy + real-shape fixture).

criteria.text: The bridge relays a todo.updated SSE event as a WS frame carrying session id + todo list (vitest).
criteria.test_id: issue-698-c2: bridge relays todo.updated SSE as a WS frame with session id and todo list

criteria.test_id: issue-698-c4: todo.updated WS frame replaces session todo state; session-keyed isolation

criteria.test_id: issue-698-c5: panel header shows completed/total count and checklist rows have correct check states
